newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks push up to another closing high.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks push up to another closing high.

text.p: Madrid stocks rose strongly on Tuesday, with a Wall Street rally driving the indices to fresh closing highs in lower than usual turnover.
Dealers were optimistic on the outlook and expected the market to continue its record-beating run.
The Ibex-35 rose 85.36 points, 1.24 percent, to 6,969.92 and the general index gained 7.96 points, 1.33 percent, to 608.58.
"The market has room to rise further short term, despite bond weakness and lower than usual volume" said a dealer at Renta 4 brokerage.
Some were not ruling out the Ibex testing resistance at 7,000 on Wednesday.
Ibex newcomers Tubacex and Asturiana ended lower, but Viscofan rose on expectations that it will benefit from a stronger dollar, dealers said.

Endesa in particular was in the spotlight, up 4.45 percent today and having risen strongly for the past few sessions. Although analysts saw no fundamental reason for this, dealers noted the stock had broken an important technical resistance level. The government is due to sell up to 33 percent of Endesa in a public offering later this year.
